audit.whatIsWrong: Content uses Pantheon's pre-rework name 'Aegis of Zeonia' for his stun and treats 'Shield Vault' as a separate follow-up. On the live kit W Shield Vault IS the dash-stun and E Aegis Assault is the frontal-invulnerability shield. Also 'Comet Spear (empowered W)' — the empowered spear is Q. Trade strings are the lane template and cooldowns has no digits.
audit.why: Kit authority: Q Comet Spear 575 range (11-8s), W Shield Vault dash-stun (13-9s), E Aegis Assault 22-18s frontal invuln, R Grand Starfall 180/165/150s at 5500 range.
audit.corrected: All stun references renamed to Shield Vault, the shield to Aegis Assault, empowered spear to Q; cooldowns field now carries 13-9s and 22-18s; trades grounded in the W-down window and the Aegis frontal invuln.

audit.why: Packet suspectName on wants.foe[2] ('Use Grand Starfall', distance 4) is a false positive — the name matches the kit exactly; only the verb prefix differs.
